## Summary / 变更概要

What changed and why? State whether it is a source asset, research entry, documentation correction, or validation change.

## Asset references / 资产引用

Stable IDs, source/spec/demo paths, lifecycle and reuse boundary. Mention any intentionally unsupported style or target environment.

## Evidence / 验证

- [ ] Registry and local links updated where relevant.
- [ ] Source/author/license and attribution checked; no unsupported redistribution.
- [ ] Relevant tests or manual checks reported (or explain why not applicable).
- [ ] No private workspace links, credentials, real customer data or internal project fixtures.
- [ ] Changelog and generated overview refreshed if counts changed.
- [ ] Theme illustrations regenerated if style tokens or registered styles changed.

Actual commands/results, limitations, and screenshots if useful. Captures are not automatically approved visual baselines.

## Scope / 范围

Avoid unrelated feature development. Note any compatibility or migration implications.
